statement: Archival context can be highly relational, but using an ontology runtime is not required to preserve contextual relations.
actakit_implication: Borrow relation semantics selectively; reject RiC-O/OWL baseline.

statement: Rich archival relation modeling produced substantial property/class maintenance complexity and abstraction pressure.
actakit_implication: Keep simple typed relations simple; promote only relations with real attributes to association/event objects.

statement: A stable ontology still required bug-fix releases for relation semantics after 1.0.
actakit_implication: Avoid ontology-wide inference rules as canonical ActaKit semantics; explicit relational invariants are easier to audit.
